news.title: CSE professor named 2026 Faculty Innovator of the Year
news.summary_en: University of Minnesota Twin Cities Professor Paul Dauenhauer was honored with the “Faculty Innovator of the Year” award at the 2026 University of Minnesota Founder’s Day.

news.title: Boost your career with new AI summer short course
news.summary_en: The University of Minnesota is offering a new four-week summer short course to help professionals boost their careers and their productivity with new AI skills.
